chapter: Bennie Moten, Basie and the Reno
title: Bus Moten, Benny's nephew
summary: After a recess Goodwin explains Bus Moten was Benny's nephew Iris Smith, a tap dancer and pianist he followed as a kid.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, that is the -- I would think the true story of what happened to the great, the only Benny Moten. That's sort of the end of his story but I would like to carry on with Benny through the years when he was alive and playing here and giving work to so many people, including William Count Basie.
Can you tell me about some of the rooms that he played in, Baby and Crook? Who was with him, when was Moten
Swing written and who wrote it and you might also tell us about Bus Moten just after this quick break if you will hold on please.

Now Baby knew Benny very well as every one did in those days but Crook Goodwin was a definite colleague of his and they came up together and Crook probably can give information from the one and the only Benny Moten that has never been seen in print before and I think will be of interest to the world and to the future generations. Crook.
Art, I might go back to the time -- I think at this time I'll inject Bus Moten.
Bus was Benny's nephew. His name was not Bus Molton. His name was Iris Smith. He was Benny's sister's child. Everybody thought that Benny was Bus's father but actually he was his uncle.
Many people thought they were brothers too, you know.

Yeah, but this was what their kinship was. He was Bus's uncle but they were very close. I remember Bus when we were young kids going along and I would follow Bus all over town because Bus was one of the few guys in the gang who could walk on his hands. He was great and adept at anything he would do. He could -- he was a good

tap dancer, a beautiful tap dancer. He could have made his living that way. He played piano, which he played beautifully, which when he died he was still doing a single on piano. He played, of course, with Benny's band but before I got into that part of it, I would like to go back to the time when I knew Benny when I was a kid.
